None present for the petitioners even in revised call.
Sri Rajiv Gupta, learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State-respondents is present.

2. The prayer made in the instant petition is for a direction to the Collector, Ghaziabad to refer the dispute relating to enhancement of compensation payable to the petitioners under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 to the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Authority in terms of Section 64.
3.

sentences.text: any reference was made by the Collector to the Authority and hence the instant petition.

4. The second proviso to sub-section 1 of Section 64 stipulates that where the Collector fails to make reference within specified period it is open to the applicant to apply to the Authority requesting it to direct the Collector to make reference to it within a period of 30 days.
Thus the petitioners have efficacious alternative remedy available to them for getting the dispute referred to the Authority.
5. Consequently, the instant petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to avail the said remedy, if so advised.
(Donadi Ramesh, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 11.9.2023/
